summary: IEEE-library form of three-position selector returning from left: this three-position selector has a documented spring return from its left position.
description: This reference locates three-position selector returning from left in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 position selector switches family. This three-position selector has a documented spring return from its left position. Other positions may be stable or have different behaviour, so the return direction must remain explicit. The public library uses HSS113L for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Establish the rest position and the state after the left-hand command is released. Return from left is not equivalent to return from both outer positions. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
